description: A contemporary residential boundary wall corner photographed at dusk with a soft pink-mauve sky fading behind a row of tall columnar cypress or arborvitae trees. A square textured stucco pillar in a warm gray tone stands at the corner where a horizontal cedar or redwood slat fence panel meets the structure. The fence planks are horizontal, medium-stained warm brown, tightly spaced. The pillar has a raised cap detail. A warm amber glow radiates outward from the top of the pillar in all four directions, illuminating the textured stucco face and washing light downward. At the base of the pillar and fence, a lush perennial garden border blooms with clusters of white daisy flowers and spikes of purple lavender, their colors luminous against the dark background. A slim painted metal or aluminum balustrade railing is visible at the left edge of the frame, suggesting a deck edge. The rear of a modern flat-roofed home is visible in the upper left background with an illuminated soffit edge creating a warm horizontal line. The palette is warm gray stucco, cedar-tone wood, white daisy, lavender purple, and a soft pink-mauve sky. Camera at standing eye-level, three-quarter corner composition at normal focal length showing the pillar corner, fence, and garden border. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
